anomalies.observed: Both isolated CAN transceivers have their isolated-side ground pins tied to the main board GND: U10.4 (GND1) and U10.5 (GND2), and U11.4 (GND1) and U11.5 (GND2), all on net GND. The CAN side (VCC2) is fed from the non-isolated 5V_switched_CAN rail, and CANL/CANH go to J2/J13 with D9/D10 referenced to GND.
anomalies.expected: The spec describes the CAN buses as isolated, using an isolated CAN transceiver. For isolation, GND2 (pins 5) must be separate from GND1 (pin 4), with its own isolated supply and ground net.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) ... U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in)
5V_switched_CAN : C15.2(2,passive) C16.2(2,passive) J13.7(Pin_7,passive) J2.7(Pin_7,passive) JP8.2(B,passive) Q9.3(D,passive) U10.8(VCC2,power_in) U11.8(VCC2,power_in)
two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: The CAN bus side shares ground with the CM4 board, so the galvanic isolation the design relies on is absent. Ground loops and common-mode noise from the motor and e-stop wiring can reach the logic side, and the isolation barrier does not protect against faults.

anomalies.observed: The anodes of three status LEDs (D4, D14, D23) are on net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW, and no other pin is on that net. No source or switch connects it to +3V3 or any other rail.
anomalies.expected: A net that supplies LED anodes should be driven from a supply, possibly through a switch. Otherwise the LEDs (ETH link/activity and PI activity indicators) cannot light.
anomalies.impact: Ethernet link/activity and Pi activity indicators would stay dark, so the board gives no status indication for those functions.

parsed.summary: The netlist is largely consistent with the spec and the SPICE view, but the two isolated CAN transceivers have their isolated-side grounds (GND1 and GND2) tied together on the main GND net, which defeats the isolation the spec describes. A secondary possibility is an unpowered LED anode net. Confidence is moderate because the isolation tie could be an original design choice.
